tabs.html:
MikroTik CRS326-24S+2Q+RM – High-Performance 40G & 10G Fiber Switch

Ultimate 40G QSFP+ & 10G SFP+ Cloud Router Switch for Enterprise & Data Centers

The MikroTik CRS326-24S+2Q+RM is a powerful Layer 3 cloud router switch, designed for high-speed networking, data centers, ISPs, and enterprise networks. With 24 x 10G SFP+ ports and 2 x 40G QSFP+ cages, this switch delivers exceptional bandwidth, ultra-fast data transfer, and seamless scalability for high-performance networking environments.


Featuring dual boot support for RouterOS L5 and SwitchOS, this switch offers the flexibility to function as an advanced Layer 3 switch or a robust router, making it an ideal choice for demanding network infrastructures.


Key Features 

  • Ultra-High-Speed Networking – 24 x 10G SFP+ ports & 2 x 40G QSFP+ ports for blazing-fast data transfers.
  • Enterprise-Grade Performance – Optimized for high-bandwidth applications & backbone networking.
  • Dual Boot System – Choose between RouterOS L5 or SwitchOS for maximum network flexibility.
  • Reliable Network Management – 1 x LAN port dedicated for device management.
  • High-Speed Switching Capacity – 640 Gbps total throughput for uncompromised performance.
  • 1U Rackmount Design – Perfect fit for enterprise & data center racks.
  • Redundant Power Supply – Dual PSU ensures uninterrupted operation & reliability.
  • Made for Performance & Longevity – Manufactured by MikroTik, Latvia for high durability.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Ensuring peace of mind with after-sales support.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CRS326-24S+2Q+RM
  • 40G QSFP+ Ports: 2 x 40G QSFP+ cages
  • 10G SFP+ Ports: 24 x 10G SFP+ cages
  • Management Port: 1 x Gigabit LAN
  • Operating System: RouterOS L5 / SwitchOS (dual boot)
  • Switching Capacity: 640 Gbps
  • Form Factor: 1U rackmount metal enclosure
  • Power Supply: Dual redundant PSU for maximum uptime
  • Manufacturing Origin: Made in Latvia
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise & Data Center Networking – Scalable, high-speed backbone connectivity.
  • ISPs & Cloud Service Providers – Reliable, high-bandwidth infrastructure for seamless data flow.
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC) – Optimized for low-latency, high-throughput workloads.
  • Large-Scale Video Streaming & Content Delivery – Handles heavy data loads with ease.


Why Choose MikroTik CRS326-24S+2Q+RM?

  • Cost-Effective 40G & 10G Solution – High-speed connectivity at an affordable price.
  • Scalable & Future-Proof – Supports growing network demands with flexible port options.
  • Seamless Performance & Reliability – Redundant power supply ensures continuous operation.
  • Enterprise-Ready Features – Optimized for demanding networking environments.
